title: FIPS mode deactivation path undocumented in registry.c
description: fips_provider_count in crypto2dev_registry.c (line 36) has no comment explaining that the only way to exit FIPS enforcement mode is to rmmod all FIPS providers. A support engineer investigating a site where non-FIPS algorithms are returning -ENOENT would look at fips_provider_count and search for a toggle flag or sysctl knob — and find nothing. The absence of an explanatory comment means debugging time is wasted and there is risk that an engineer attempts workarounds instead of the correct procedure (rmmod crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko). The operational consequence at CMVP audit is that deployment documentation and incident-response runbooks may not describe the deactivation procedure, a gap reviewers will flag. Fix: add a block comment above fips_provider_count stating that FIPS enforcement is activated by the first is_fips provider registration and can only be deactivated by unloading all FIPS provider modules (rmmod crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko), and that there is intentionally no runtime toggle.
